name: o-mods
description: Claude Code mods by omeerdvrn: sidebars, panes and hooks for everyday work.

plugins.name: heat
plugins.description: NBA-Jam-style heat tracker: prompts and tool calls heat you up, idle time cools you down, and a fire burst rises above the prompt as you get hot.

plugins.name: linear
plugins.description: Sidebar of your assigned Linear issues; Start creates a git worktree and begins implementing the issue.

plugins.name: usage-bar
plugins.description: Shows your 5-hour and weekly plan limits, used or remaining, and the session's git branch or worktree under the prompt.

plugins.name: usage-stats
plugins.description: Your Claude Code usage on this machine as a receipt: total tokens, prompts, sessions, issues closed, daily activity, and tokens by project and model. Opens with /usage-stats.

plugins.name: persona
plugins.description: Pick a role for Claude on this machine (UI/UX, Backend, Dev, QA, Docs, PM); edits and shell commands outside the role are denied, and the Claude crab dressed for the role shows under the prompt.

plugins.name: pr-status
plugins.description: Live CI status of the current branch's pull request above the prompt, or of any PR you pin with /pr-status <number>. Detects GitHub, GitLab, Gitea/Forgejo, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps.

plugins.name: themes
plugins.description: Color themes for Claude Code (Catppuccin, Dracula, Nord, Tokyo Night, Gruvbox, Rosé Pine and more). Each new session opens in the next theme, so sessions are easy to tell apart; /themes picks or pins one.

plugins.name: task-router
plugins.description: Routes each task to a worker subagent on the right model tier (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus) by rules you own, tracks it in a registry, and shows each model as a Claude crab in a status sidebar. Integrates with Superpowers.

plugins.name: scenes
plugins.description: Animated pixel scenes above the prompt while Claude works, a random one each time (night drive, rainy window, fish tank, space flight, lo-fi room, campfire, ocean sunset, matrix rain, usage weather), event bursts, and a companion crab that acts out what Claude does. Drawn, no images.

plugins.name: huh
plugins.description: /huh opens Claude's last answer in the sidebar, rewritten to be easy to read (a short summary first, clear sections, lists), with the original one click away.

plugins.name: snippets
plugins.description: The input bar, smarter: Linear tickets in the typeahead, live highlighting (tickets, paths, @mentions, secrets), and ;;snippets that expand as you type.

plugins.name: faah
plugins.description: Meme sounds on events: FAAAH when tests fail, anime wow when they pass, bruh when Claude asks you something. More events and your own clips with /faah.
